subject: general
question: What is the maximum score possible for project design evaluation in the application form process of the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1400**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The maximum score for project design evaluation in the** Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)** application form process is **1400 points**.
 
• This evaluation score is used to assess the quality and feasibility of the project proposals submitted by implementing partners.
 
• The scoring system ensures that only well-structured and impactful projects are approved for implementation under the scheme.
 
• DDU-GKY focuses on skill development and aims to improve employability among rural youth, particularly those from disadvantaged sections of society.
 
• The project evaluation process plays a critical role in ensuring transparency and the selection of high-quality projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)**

 
 
• Launched on **September 25, 2014**, under the **Ministry of Rural Development **(MoRD).
 
• Aims to transform rural poor youth into an economically independent and globally relevant workforce.
 
• Targets youth between the ages of 15 and 35 years from rural areas, with special focus on marginalized communities like SCs, STs, and minorities.
 
• DDU-GKY is a part of the **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)** and is aligned with the '**Skill India**' mission.
 
 
 
• **Project Design Evaluation Criteria**
 
 
• Evaluation is based on several parameters including training plan, post-placement support, and infrastructure readiness.
 
• Projects that score higher are considered better prepared to deliver quality outcomes for beneficiaries.
 
 
 
• **Skill Development in Rural India**
 
 
• India has a significant rural population, and skill development initiatives like DDU-GKY are crucial for reducing unemployment and poverty.
 
• Programs focus on industry-relevant skills to ensure better job opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Funding and Implementation**
 
 
• DDU-GKY is funded jointly by the central and state governments.
 
• Implemented through Project Implementing Agencies (PIAs) that submit proposals for approval.
